empirical_fpr.interpretation: Conditional on user-declared unwatermarked natural images. No threshold retuning. Zero observations does not prove zero FPR.

fpr_calibration: theoretical fair-independent-bit null, not empirical FPR

uncertainty.tpr_drop: paired image percentile bootstrap; 2000 resamples; seed 3407
uncertainty.interpretation: Nominal pointwise intervals assume independent image units, conditional on this model/key and prompt sampling scheme; not simultaneous, across-model uncertainty, or evidence that hand-written prompts represent a deployment population. Bootstrap intervals may degenerate with identical paired outcomes.

reference_validation.interpretation: Failure suggests a key/extractor/fixture/preprocessing mismatch or a weak marked baseline; attack effects are not scientifically interpretable.

key_provenance.source: facebookresearch/stable_signature public SD2 decoder example key

warning: These metrics must not be fed back into the attacker selection in the same blind experiment.
